description: This Java class 'PackageValidator' is responsible for validating whether a calling package is authorized to access a MediaBrowserService in an Android application. It reads allowed callers' certificates from an XML resource, verifies signatures, and checks package names to enforce access control.

classes.name: PackageValidator
classes.description: Class that verifies if a calling package is authorized to access media browsing services by validating its signature and package name against a predefined list from XML resource.

methods.name: PackageValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with the list of allowed certificates by parsing an XML resource.

methods.name: readValidCertificates
methods.description: Parses the XML resource defining allowed signing certificates and associated package info, populating a map for validation.

methods.name: isCallerAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a caller identified by package name and UID is authorized based on signature and package name validation.
